name: Dangling Ingress backend
description: An Ingress whose backend references a Service that does not exist in the same namespace produces broken routing with no traffic. It typically results from a Service being renamed, deleted, or a typo in the backend service name.
long_description: Ingress resources route external HTTP/HTTPS traffic to internal cluster Services. If an Ingress backend references a Service name that does not exist in the namespace, the ingress controller cannot establish upstream routes, causing 502/503 errors and complete disruption of incoming traffic. This usually happens after a service deletion, renaming, or misspelling in routing configurations. Ensuring all Ingress backend targets exist guarantees seamless traffic forwarding.
remediation: Create the referenced Service or correct the Ingress backend service name.
test: Check that every Ingress backend Service exists in the same namespace.
